title: Determination on Party Pricing of Equipment Rental and Demo Agreements
content:
## Agreements opened together for one household

Agreements opened together for one household are priced as a party. This determination records which reductions of the Equipment Rental and Demo line are taken on such a party, on what evidence, and in what order against one another.

### 1. The passholder reduction

*The clause reading "The season passholder reduction is taken per rider, on the evidence of a pass registered to that rider standing in the active state, and it is not lent from one rider to another" is **no longer in force**. It is retired and superseded by the current basis on which the package's passholder share is taken; it is set out here only so that no reader applies the withdrawn wording.*

The percentages themselves stand unchanged: each package of the line carries its own passholder share, its own lesson bundle share and its own lodging bundle share.

### 2. The bundle reductions

The lesson bundle reduction is taken where the same rider also holds a snowsports school booking over the same dates. The lodging bundle reduction is taken where the household holds collective lodging over the same dates.

Where more than one bundle reduction would apply to the same agreement, only the largest is taken; they are never added together.

### 3. Where the bundle reduction acts

Bundle reductions are worked out on the rate after the passholder reduction and before any advance booking reduction.

### 4. A holding given up afterwards

A booking that later loses the holding it was bundled with keeps the reduction it was given at the time.

### The bundle rules as a decision table

| Rider holds a school booking over the same dates | Household holds collective lodging over the same dates | Bundle reduction taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the larger of the package's lesson bundle share and its lodging bundle share, taken once |
| yes | no | the package's lesson bundle share |
| no | yes | the package's lodging bundle share |
| no | no | none |

### Points of judgement

**On a household where one rider is in ski school and the whole family is in a collective residence (hypothetical).** Both bundle grounds stand against that rider's agreement. One reduction is taken, the larger of the two shares the package carries, and the two are not added.

**On a household that gives up the residence after the rental was booked (hypothetical).** The agreement keeps the reduction it was given at the time the booking was made.

**On the order of the three reductions.** Whatever bundle share is taken is worked out on the rate as it stands after the passholder reduction, and before any advance booking reduction is taken.

superseded_clauses: The season passholder reduction is taken per rider, on the evidence of a pass registered to that rider standing in the active state, and it is not lent from one rider to another.
